messages:
Michelle: Quick midweek poll — editors + lunch 2-question thread.
Pick one editor and one lunch option in your reply, e.g. "vscode tacos". Options — Editors: vscode / neovim / jetbrains / code-server. Lunch: tacos / poké / salad / sandwiches.

Raj: vscode poké :raised_hands:

Kevin: neovim tacos

Tara: jetbrains salad! trying to be good today :salad:

Olivia: vscode tacos (ordering from Taqueria Norte?) https://taquerianorte.example/menu :taco:

Michelle: loving the specificity. i'll tally at 11:20am

lunch-bot: Poll summary — vscode: 2, neovim:1, jetbrains:1; tacos:3, poké:1, salad:1. React with :+1: to confirm your selection.

Raj: also vscode for the win — moving to PR later :sweat_smile:

Kevin: if tacos wins we should get a variety pack (al pastor, pescado) — tagging @Olivia to confirm order

Olivia: yep i can place the order. preference: al pastor :ok_hand:

Tara: :thumbsup: sounds good

Michelle: final call 11:25am. thanks everyone! :coffee:
